summary: Frontend-only verification: All 4 one-click demo logins (Admin/Partner/Customer/Merchant) succeed with no CORS/'Demo login failed' errors and redirect to the correct portals. Admin Branding & Theme SVG upload works end-to-end (POST /api/media/upload returns 200 with a .svg url, preview renders, and 'Image uploaded' toast appears). PNG upload also works (server converts to .webp, preview shown, toast appears).

minor.issue: Returns 403 for the demo partner on partner portal load (repeated 4x). Not blocking login, but partner UI may miss alert preferences. Auth/role check likely rejecting the demo partner token for this route.

issues: Multiple Recharts console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - responsive container renders before parent has layout. Cosmetic but noisy in console.

action_items: Investigate /api/partner/alert-prefs 403 for demo partner token (role permission or route dependency check).
Optional: add min-height/min-width to Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents on the admin analytics dashboard to remove chart size warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: web_panel/.env intentionally keeps REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL empty so api.js falls back to same-origin '/api' - this correctly avoids CORS in the preview environment.

ImageUpload component's data-testid='image-upload-btn' is on the <label>, not the underlying <input type=file>. Consider putting the testid on the input for cleaner test targeting (worked around in tests by using input[type=file]).
